requirements.text: User should be able to log into the application using a valid username and password. In case of invalid credentials, a clear error banner must be displayed without exposing backend system details.
The payment API must accept VISA, Mastercard, and Amex cards. Transactions above $10,000 require two-factor authentication. Zero or negative amounts must return HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Users can search products by keyword with auto-complete. Results should load in under 500ms and paginate 20 items per page. Special SQL/HTML characters should be sanitized.
